plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.49 arcseconds per year, measured over 14 years (a very confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = 2.10 mag is very red, like T-type brown dwarfs.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a T5 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (T6) fits clearly worse.
